subject: SIG: attachments index & QA logistics for evidence handoff
messages:
From: Lara Quinn <lara.quinn@greenbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greenbridge.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG request — attachments and timeline

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. GreenBridge is moving our vendor review to the final stage and we need the SIG attachment set so our InfoSec team can complete assessment. Specifically we need:
- Company policies (security, incident response, data retention)
- Network diagram(s) and brief hosting topology notes
- KMS/runbook for key rotation and access
- Representative screenshots for login/auth flows and admin controls
- A manifest (csv or spreadsheet) listing filenames + short descriptions

Preferred delivery: Drive folder with share links and a brief manifest. Target date: 2026-08-10 EOD. We may ask for a follow-up screen session if anything is unclear.

Can you confirm and let me know who on your side will be the point-of-contact for uploads?

Cheers,
Lara
Lara Quinn
Head of InfoSec Programs, GreenBridge Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Quinn <lara.quinn@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — attachments and timeline

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear list. I’ll own the handoff from our side and coordinate uploads. Quick plan:
1) Security will drop final policy PDFs and the kms_runbook into a Drive folder (I’ll share with your addresses)
2) Marissa will pull screenshots and the network diagram; we’ll redact any internal hostnames per your guidance
3) We’ll attach an evidence_manifest.csv with short descriptions and tagging (policy, diagram, runbook, screenshot)

Tentative timeline: initial upload by 2026-08-04, final QA & manifest by 2026-08-06 so you have cushion. If you need everything by 08/10 we’re on track.

CCing Karthik for procurement / access gating (if you need an NDA or temporary viewer permissions) and Marissa for redaction/QA.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — attachments and timeline

Ben / team — I’ll upload the baseline security docs today and the KMS runbook tomorrow morning. Items I plan to include:
- redwood_security_policy_v2.pdf (security & incident response sections highlighted)
- data_retention_policy_2026.pdf
- kms_runbook.md (rotation schedule, roles, example commands)
- session_logs_obfuscation_sample.txt (sample sanitized logs)

I’ll place everything in a new folder: /GreenBridge_SIG_Handoff/ and set share to 'Anyone with link' but restrict editing. Please confirm if you want viewer-only access or need us to add specific accounts.

Priyom

Date: 2026-08-03T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — attachments and timeline

Quick notes on screenshots and redaction:
- I’ll capture admin UI screens for user management and the token usage page (filenames below).
- Network diagram will be a single-page PNG showing region, VPCs, and load-balancing layer — I’ll annotate public vs private subnets.
- Redaction: we will replace internal IPs/hostnames with placeholders (e.g., HOST_01).

Planned artifacts to add:
- network_infra_diagram_v1.png
- screenshot_user_auth_flow.png
- screenshot_admin_user_mgmt.png
- runbook_kms_rotation.md (short-form operational steps)

I also recommend a short QA pass after upload (10–15m video call) so we can confirm links and redaction. Availability: 2026-08-04 14:00–16:00 PT.

Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Customer Security

Date: 2026-08-05T16:40:00-07:00

Lara / Tom — we uploaded the requested artifacts and did a quick QA pass. Below are the Drive links and a short manifest. Please confirm that you can access everything; if anything needs additional redaction or a screen walkthrough, we’re happy to schedule.

Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood_SIG_GreenBridge
Evidence manifest: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ManifestId/view (evidence_manifest.csv)
Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Redwood-SIG-checklist (SIG checklist / mapping to CAIQ sections)

Included files (manifest excerpt):
- redwood_security_policy_v2.pdf — master security & incident response policy
- data_retention_policy_2026.pdf — retention schedule and deletion flow
- network_infra_diagram_v1.png — annotated topology (public/private layers)
- kms_runbook.md / runbook_kms_rotation.md — key rotation steps and roles
- session_logs_obfuscation_sample.txt — sanitized example logs
- screenshot_user_auth_flow.png — login + MFA flow screenshot

Follow-up: Marissa can run a 15-min call on 2026-08-06 09:00 PT to confirm access and discuss redaction if needed. If that works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite.
